categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Fuzzing label and modifies the shared fuzz utility src/test/fuzz/util/wallet.h and wallet fuzz harnesses.
categories.rationale: Reusing the fuzzed wallet instance across iterations yields an observed 4x to 6x speedup in wallet fuzz harness throughput. The author reports a ~6x speedup on Ubuntu without sanitizers, and reviewers confirmed a ~4x speedup on the qa-assets corpus. Increasing fuzz throughput has clear value for bug discovery, though harness speed ranks below flaky test fixes and CI reliability.
